instruction:
You are a wastewater process engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-10 chemical dosing, storage, and containment package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Chemical dosing, bund containment, pump selection, and 4-20 mA scaling workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse a real source pack, vendor export, or authority-approved design.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-10-LH-03`
- Process flow/load table: `FLOW-10-CHEM-03`
- Chemical dosing basis: `DOSE-10-BASIS-03`
- Tank/storage schedule: `TANK-10-STORAGE-03`
- Bund detail: `BUND-10-DETAIL-03`
- Pump/control schedule: `PUMP-10-CONTROL-03`
- Chemical system memo: `MEMO-10-CHEM-03`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Process flow | {{ flow_rate_m3_d }} m3/d |
| Chemical dose | {{ chemical_dose_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Solution strength | {{ solution_strength_kg_l }} kg/L |
| Required storage | {{ required_storage_days }} d |
| Installed storage | {{ installed_storage_m3 }} m3 |
| Largest tank | {{ largest_tank_m3 }} m3 |
| Bund factor | {{ bund_factor }} |
| Rain allowance | {{ rain_allowance_m3 }} m3 |
| Available bund | {{ bund_available_m3 }} m3 |
| Pump operating hours | {{ pump_operating_hours_d }} h/d |
| Selected pump capacity | {{ selected_pump_capacity_l_h }} L/h |
| Signal range | {{ signal_range_l_h }} L/h |

## Calculation Rules

- Chemical mass equals `flow_rate_m3_d x chemical_dose_mg_l / 1000`.
- Solution volume equals chemical mass divided by solution strength.
- Required storage equals daily solution volume times required storage days.
- Refill margin equals installed storage duration minus required storage duration.
- Bund required equals largest tank times bund factor plus rain allowance.
- Dosing pump flow equals daily solution volume divided by pump operating hours.
- Design signal equals `4 + 16 x dosing_pump_flow_l_h / signal_range_l_h`.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when refill, bund, pump capacity, and signal headroom margins are non-negative.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "chemical_mass_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "solution_volume_l_d": <numeric_value>,
  "required_storage_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "refill_margin_d": <numeric_value>,
  "bund_required_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "bund_margin_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "dosing_pump_flow_l_h": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_capacity_margin_l_h": <numeric_value>,
  "design_signal_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "signal_headroom_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-10 chemical dosing, storage, and containment template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one flow, dose, storage, bund, pump, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "chemical-dosing-storage-containment-package"
description = "SSC-10 chemical dosing, storage, and containment metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound chemical dosing metrics from a deterministic SSC-10 task-owned source pack. The template combines dose mass, solution volume, storage refill margin, bund volume, dosing pump flow, control signal, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "chemical-dosing-containment"
standards = ["chemical dosing workflow", "bund containment workflow", "4-20 mA loop scaling"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "chemical", "dosing", "storage", "bund", "pump", "control", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.flow_rate_m3_d]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/d"
description = "FLOW-10-CHEM-03 process flow"
min = 4800.0
max = 4800.0

[params.chemical_dose_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "DOSE-10-BASIS-03 chemical dose"
min = 38.0
max = 38.0

[params.solution_strength_kg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/L"
description = "DOSE-10-BASIS-03 solution strength"
min = 0.48
max = 0.48

[params.required_storage_days]
type = "float"
unit = "d"
description = "TANK-10-STORAGE-03 required storage duration"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.installed_storage_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "TANK-10-STORAGE-03 installed storage"
min = 7.8
max = 7.8

[params.largest_tank_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "BUND-10-DETAIL-03 largest tank"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.bund_factor]
type = "float"
description = "BUND-10-DETAIL-03 containment factor"
min = 1.1
max = 1.1

[params.rain_allowance_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "BUND-10-DETAIL-03 rain allowance"
min = 0.25
max = 0.25

[params.bund_available_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "BUND-10-DETAIL-03 available bund volume"
min = 8.2
max = 8.2

[params.pump_operating_hours_d]
type = "float"
unit = "h/d"
description = "PUMP-10-CONTROL-03 daily dosing pump operating hours"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.selected_pump_capacity_l_h]
type = "float"
unit = "L/h"
description = "PUMP-10-CONTROL-03 selected pump capacity"
min = 22.0
max = 22.0

[params.signal_range_l_h]
type = "float"
unit = "L/h"
description = "PUMP-10-CONTROL-03 20 mA pump signal range"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[outputs.chemical_mass_kg_d]
description = "Daily chemical mass"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.solution_volume_l_d]
description = "Daily dosing solution volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_storage_m3]
description = "Required chemical storage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.refill_margin_d]
description = "Installed refill margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bund_required_m3]
description = "Required bund volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bund_margin_m3]
description = "Available bund volume minus required bund volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.dosing_pump_flow_l_h]
description = "Required dosing pump flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_capacity_margin_l_h]
description = "Selected pump capacity minus required pump flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.design_signal_ma]
description = "Design 4-20 mA signal"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.signal_headroom_ma]
description = "20 mA minus design signal"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when storage, bund, pump, and signal margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
